ForgerEMS - Windows ISO Workflow
Modern Windows (10, 11, Server)
DOWNLOAD - Windows 10.url        Official Microsoft Windows 10 download page.
DOWNLOAD - Windows 11.url        Official Microsoft Windows 11 download page.
DOWNLOAD - Windows Server Eval.url   Microsoft Evaluation Center (Server 2025).
GUIDE - Windows ADK + WinPE.url  Microsoft Learn ADK / WinPE reference.
- Microsoft Media Creation Tool may be required to materialize the ISO.
- ISO availability depends on the Microsoft download flow.
- Licensing still required.
- Do not use third-party ISO mirrors.
Manual ISO drop zones
Drop your legally obtained ISO into the matching folder under:
Windows-Manual-ISO-Drop\Windows 11\
Windows-Manual-ISO-Drop\Windows 10\

One ISO per folder is enough. The folder name pins which version the ISO is for.
Legacy Windows (8.1 and older)
See ISO\Windows-Legacy\README - Legacy Windows media.txt for the legacy policy,
firmware caveats, driver notes, and Ventoy compatibility guidance.
ForgerEMS never auto-downloads legacy Windows ISOs.
Security and licensing
- Use original or client-owned, legally licensed media only.
- Do not use random internet ISO mirrors.
- Microsoft EULAs apply to all Windows media.
ForgerEMS - Legacy Windows media policy
ForgerEMS cannot auto-download legacy Windows ISOs because Microsoft no longer
provides a public official ISO flow for them. Manual ISO required for:
Windows 8.1, Windows 8, Windows 7, Windows Vista, Windows XP,
Windows 2000, Windows ME, Windows 98, Windows 95.
Drop ISOs into ISO\Windows\Windows-Manual-ISO-Drop\<version>\.
Rules
- Use original or client-owned, legally licensed media only.
- Do not use random internet ISO mirrors.
- Microsoft EULA applies. Treat older Windows as unsupported by vendor.
- Use only for recovery, retro systems, or isolated labs.
- NEVER expose legacy Windows installs to the public internet.
Firmware and Secure Boot
- Windows 7 / 8 / 8.1: BIOS and UEFI both possible; Secure Boot may need to
be disabled on modern firmware.
- Windows Vista: BIOS preferred; Secure Boot unsupported.
- XP / 2000 / ME / 98 / 95: legacy BIOS / CSM required; Secure Boot unsupported.
Drivers and storage
- XP / 2000 may need AHCI / SATA drivers loaded via F6 or slipstreamed; old
install media often only sees IDE storage.
- 9x (ME / 98 / 95) typically need IDE compatibility mode and a DOS boot disk.
- USB boot support is limited on very old systems; an optical drive or VM may
be required.
Ventoy compatibility
- Modern Windows 7 / 8.1 installers usually boot from Ventoy.
- Older installers (XP and below) vary; expect to fall back to bare-metal
install media or a VM.
- For 9x installers, a DOS boot disk and legacy BIOS are typically required.
